name: criminalBackground
description: Appearances, histories, and goals for criminal NPCs

fields.Appearance: Unremarkable clothing, forgettable features, and hands kept carefully out of sight.
fields.Backstory: Learned pickpocketing as a hungry child and became too useful for the gang to release.
fields.Goals: Buy freedom from the gang and disappear before a younger sibling is recruited.

fields.Appearance: Expensively dressed but tense, with polished manners and a recently broken nose.
fields.Backstory: A legitimate merchant began smuggling when impossible taxes threatened the business.
fields.Goals: Remove the corrupt customs chief and return to legal trade without losing everything.

fields.Appearance: Lean, scarred, and dressed for rapid movement with no visible identifying marks.
fields.Backstory: Deserted an abusive military unit and survived by robbing officials along remote roads.
fields.Goals: Protect other deserters and expose the commander who created them.

fields.Appearance: Friendly face, theatrical smile, and fashionable clothes supported by hidden armor.
fields.Backstory: Built a confidence scheme around false inheritances and accidentally uncovered a real conspiracy.
fields.Goals: Complete one final profitable deception and escape everyone now hunting the evidence.

fields.Appearance: Heavy-set, carefully tattooed, and outwardly relaxed while constantly watching exits.
fields.Backstory: Began as a dock enforcer and inherited leadership after every superior was arrested.
fields.Goals: Turn the gang into a stable business and prevent a violent rival takeover.

fields.Appearance: Pale from indoor work, with precise fingers and permanent traces of ink and metal dust.
fields.Backstory: A gifted artisan was imprisoned for forging documents requested by a noble patron.
fields.Goals: Destroy the patron's reputation and create an identity no authority can question.

fields.Appearance: Travel-stained, charming, and equipped with several knives used mostly as tools.
fields.Backstory: Joined bandits after losing land to debt collectors and became their reluctant negotiator.
fields.Goals: Keep the group from killing, recover the seized land, and secure amnesty.

fields.Appearance: Severe posture, official clothing, and a signet worn as though it were a weapon.
fields.Backstory: A minor magistrate discovered bribery was safer and more profitable than honest enforcement.
fields.Goals: Erase incriminating records and gain enough influence to become untouchable.

fields.Appearance: Elegant, soft-voiced, and protected by gloves regardless of the weather.
fields.Backstory: Trained as an apothecary before secretly supplying poisons and antidotes to competing clients.
fields.Goals: Monopolize a rare ingredient and avoid choosing sides in an approaching succession crisis.

fields.Appearance: Young, restless, and visibly trying to imitate a feared criminal reputation.
fields.Backstory: Committed one reckless robbery and received credit for a string of crimes performed by someone else.
fields.Goals: Survive the unwanted fame and discover who is using the name.

fields.Appearance: Weather-beaten sailor with ritual scars, practical jewelry, and an easy laugh.
fields.Backstory: Turned pirate after a merchant captain abandoned half the crew during a storm.
fields.Goals: Hunt exploitative ships, provide for the old crew, and someday own a lawful harbor.

fields.Appearance: Quiet and meticulously clean, with an old burn hidden beneath the collar.
fields.Backstory: Was raised inside an assassins' order and failed the first assignment intentionally.
fields.Goals: Free other trainees and dismantle the order without becoming the killer it designed.
